title: FLA import: symbol linkage export not decoded — golden emits ExportAssets, ours emits none
description: Golden-pair oracle deviation. Golden SWF emits ExportAssets {id:2, name:'Coin'} — the 'Coin' movieclip is exported for ActionScript/linkage in the source FLA. Our loadFla() imports Coin with no linkage (linkageId/exportForActionScript unset), so compileDocument emits no ExportAssets (golden-report: ExportAssets ours=0/golden=1). Fix the FLA Contents-stream linkage decode so Coin's export identifier survives import. Acceptance: golden-report shows ExportAssets 1/1. Related (done): 0863, 0937, 0297.
